policy: Build one short card per verified custom, not one per book observation or regional variant.
Retain original historical wording only as a source locator; all display text is independently drafted.
Regional practice and ministerial ritual are clearly delimited; no unpublished legal or 1962 ceremonial claims.
Calendar, Saints, Pray and existing Customs Atlas own the displayed surfaces; no parallel mini prayerbook.
Only independent source support allows a finished editorial draft; an app release still requires review and tests.
Each corroborated draft carries English and French description, meaning and voluntary observation copy; French titles alone are insufficient for release.
